subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The voting system showed that technology does not automatically create good participation.”?
options: It asks whether every student can actually use it.
It helped students see habits that had become automatic.
Tools amplify habits, whether serious or careless.
It is about building habits before trouble arrives.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It asks whether every student can actually use it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It helped students see habits that had become automatic.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The voting system showed that technology does not automatically create good participation. Tools amplify habits, whether serious or careless.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It is about building habits before trouble arrives.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The voting system showed that technology does not automatically create good participation. Tools amplify habits, whether serious or careless.」，答案為「Tools amplify habits, whether serious or careless.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Tools amplify habits, whether serious or careless.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
